data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 20.974m. During 2019 the syndicate recorded unfavourable prior year claims development of GBP 1.812m (net of reinsurance), driven by adverse development in the reinsurance and property-related lines; no gross prior-year movement figure is disclosed in the notes. The claims development triangle only contains 2018 and 2019 underwriting years, preventing a gross PYD calculation from the triangle.

data.data_quality_notes: No gross prior-year reserve movement (insurance liabilities) is disclosed. The only explicit quantified prior-year movement is stated as a net (after reinsurance) adverse development of GBP 1.8m in the claims note; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the net figure and is flagged as such. The year-of-account breakdown elsewhere (a 2018 year of account profit of GBP 3.1m) appears to contradict the net claims adverse movement (this likely reflects investment/other items versus claims movement). The gross claims development triangle is present but only contains 2018 and 2019 underwriting years, so it cannot be used to compute prior-year development for years <=2017. Line-by-line PYD amounts were taken from the note's per-LOB table (which appears to be presented in GBP 000) and converted to millions; small rounding mismatches exist between per-LOB components and the stated total.
